verdict.rationale: ROS 2 ships an official, documented `ros2` command-line entry point. Its sub-commands cover introspecting and working with nodes, topics and services, and also bag record/play, `doctor`, `security` and `trace`, all on an extensible framework. This covers the story's core ask of using an official CLI. missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented affordances such as machine-readable/structured output or non-interactive automation guidance for AI-native workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond a passing community mention of CLI tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The main entry point for the tools is the command ros2, which itself has various sub-commands for introspecting and working with nodes, topics, services, and more.

Command-line introspection tools using an extensible framework
